findings.summary: The section does not cover an outline point (missing "unassignable", "reference").

findings.summary: Collections.unmodifiableList is listed under "Copy out", but it returns a read-only view and does not copy.
findings.fix: Say "Copy out: List.copyOf (a real immutable copy). Collections.unmodifiableList is only a read-only view, so later changes to the backing list show through."

findings.summary: The section does not cover an outline point (missing "constructor", "components").
